answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed loop certifying only itself — a quill signing its own name — earning nothing, because it draws no genuine edges from outside. Honest identities gather many independent vouches like a comet trailing light; a ring bolted to one jetty has only its own, so the rule starves it.
